pin_regs.reason: RTL registers every seam/pin explicitly (children: input pin flops or the wrapped module's first stage; outputs flop-driven). No extra wrapper edges.

name: qkd_ctrl_pc_sched_nc1
structural_change: KV-NCKITS 10-17 (coordinator decision 3, KV-PLAN-CI 2e2d12f42): ci-less successor of the closed qkd_ctrl_pc_sched_s7b (qkd_ctrl_pc_sched): the W-face ci_c (63 b) / co_c (12 b) pins and their pin flops, the legacy w_pend / w_go write command, HOFF hold, LATE watchdog, h_wcon / f_wmis completion check, write-done av_s / at_s and hf are removed logic (no producer of ci on the static die). Same outline, faces, recipe and pin rules as qkd_ctrl_pc_sched_s7b; every pin stays registered at the pin (flop-first in/out, hrst captured by a pin flop); 0 normal-cycle delta (lockstep vs the original with ci held 0).
slot_change_request: Drop-in for qkd_ctrl_pc_sched_s7b: same slot and faces; only the legacy ci / co pass-through pins are gone.
